core_obligations: Group (a) (proof line 9817): the implication from full faithfulness to faithfulness is immediate from the definitions.

Group (b) (proof lines 9820-9831): a commutative square relating two maps and their pullbacks shows that equality after applying the pushforward together with surjectivity of the comparison maps gives equality of the original maps.

Group (c) (proof lines 9834-9849): a similar square with isomorphisms given by property (7) shows that (7) implies reflection of injections, surjections and bijections and property (3), and the implications to (2) and (1) follow from the other groups.
Group (d) (proof lines 9852-9863): each direction is proved by an argument with the exactness of the pullback and a one-sided inverse of a canonical map.
Group (e) (proof lines 9865-9895): the author uses the characterizations of injections and surjections to translate the hypotheses and derives the implications by a diagram.
Group (f) (proof lines 9897-9943): both directions are proved, one by factoring a map through the pullback of a suitable surjection, the other by a diagram pushed down along the pushforward.

Group (g) (proof lines 9946-9955): the injection case is proved by rewriting injectivity as an isomorphism involving a fibre product and applying property (9), and the surjection and bijection cases follow from the equivalence of the three conditions.
Group (h) (proof lines 9958-9959): the equivalence between full faithfulness and the counit being an isomorphism is the cited categorical result.
proof_roadmap: Translate the properties into statements about the diagonal and codiagonal maps.
Prove the implications group by group with the diagrams displayed in the proof.
Use the cited categorical criterion for the last group.
difficulty_reason: The lemma organizes eleven exactness properties of a morphism of topoi into eight groups of implications, displayed with a picture (statement lines 9770-9814). The proof is a systematic argument: the immediate cases are noted as such (proof line 9817); the groups (b) and (c) are proved with commutative squares involving the comparison maps (proof lines 9820-9849); group (d) uses exactness of the pullback and a one-sided inverse (proof lines 9852-9863); groups (e) and (f) translate the conditions through the diagonal and codiagonal characterizations and conclude with displayed diagrams (proof lines 9865-9943); group (g) rewrites injectivity as an isomorphism and applies the previous group (proof lines 9946-9955); and group (h) is the cited categorical criterion for full faithfulness (proof lines 9958-9959). The non-formal content is the diagram bookkeeping. The claim is H2: a structured argument with every group written out.
